background_color.docs:
**[Color](https://esphome.io/components/display#color)**: Specifies the background color to use. Defaults to COLOR_OFF

*See also: [Graphical Display Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/graphical_display_menu#example-configuration-entry)*

display.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: ID of the display to render to. See [Drawing Modes](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/graphical_display_menu#drawing-modes) for more details

*See also: [Graphical Display Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/graphical_display_menu#example-configuration-entry)*

font.docs:
**[Font](https://esphome.io/components/font#display-fonts)**: Specifies the font to use

*See also: [Graphical Display Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/graphical_display_menu#example-configuration-entry)*

foreground_color.docs:
**[Color](https://esphome.io/components/display#color)**: Specifies the foreground color to use. Defaults to COLOR_ON

*See also: [Graphical Display Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/graphical_display_menu#example-configuration-entry)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Graphical Display Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/graphical_display_menu#example-configuration-entry)*

menu_item_value.docs:
**string**: Specifies how to render values for menu items that have values (eg. Selects, numbers). Defaults to rendering the value as "(value here)". Receives a MenuItemValueArguments as the argument`it`.

*See also: [Graphical Display Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/graphical_display_menu#example-configuration-entry)*

on_redraw.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when the menu needs to be redrawn. This can be useful if your display has slow refresh rates. For example E-Ink displays that are used with `display_interval: never`.

*See also: [Graphical Display Menu](https://esphome.io/components/display_menu/graphical_display_menu#example-configuration-entry)*
